description: Four synthetic rules on the stairs: both have risers of 180 mm, under 7 3/4 in; both have a headroom under Rules 0.2, which reads the document as Core 0.4 does - ST1's, at about 4' 11", and the spiral's, 180 mm under the bedroom's ceiling - and both may not meet 6' 8"; the spiral declares no handrail, so both handrail conditions fail on it; and the spiral is exempt from the tread rule as narrower than 3', while ST1's 9" treads may not meet 10". A stair's finding is on its level, L1, and draws its box.
